entities.name: Chishiro
entities.description: A large orochi samurai of Kamigawa, formerly of the Order of Jukai, bonded to the kami Kaima.

entities.name: Kaima
entities.description: A kami whose magic Chishiro channeled through his sword.

entities.name: Order of Jukai
entities.description: An order of forest samurai who hunted Futurists infringing on the forest.

entities.name: Saiba Futurists
entities.description: Futurists who set a trap that destroyed Chishiro's order.

entities.name: Mukotai Reckoners
entities.description: A group that attacked a village Chishiro protected.

entities.name: Tatsunari
entities.description: A toad rider among the Reckoners, the boy who destroyed Chishiro's bond.

entities.name: Far Corner
entities.description: A neighborhood that Chishiro was hired to protect.

events.summary: A boy poisons the Order's food, steals Chishiro's blade and kills his comrades, forcing Chishiro's bond with Kaima to break and his blade to shatter.
events.quote: After poisoning the Order's food, the boy stole Chishiro's blade, slit the throats of Chishiro's comrades

events.summary: Kaima rampages through the village and chases the boy off; Chishiro abandons his ideals and becomes a killer-for-hire.
events.quote: After that day, Chishiro abandoned his ideals and became a killer-for-hire.

events.summary: Chishiro is hired to protect Far Corner and trains the villagers against the Reckoners.
events.quote: Chishiro was hired to protect the neighborhood of Far Corner from the Mokutai Reckoners

events.summary: Chishiro recognizes Tatsunari as the boy from his past and attacks him in rage; the village's kami, which is Kaima, saves him.
events.quote: Chishiro recognized the toad rider Tatsunari as the boy from his past

events.summary: Chishiro agrees to reforge his bond with Kaima, and his blade begins to reforge as a blade of light.
events.quote: Chishiro opened himself to the kami, agreeing to reforge their bond

relations.quote: his bond with his kami companion, Kaima

relations.note: He was a member before leaving.
relations.quote: Originally a member of the Order of Jukai

relations.note: He attacked the boy who destroyed his order.
relations.quote: Gripped with rage, Chishiro attacked the boy

relations.note: Hired to defend a village from them.
relations.quote: Chishiro was hired to protect the neighborhood of Far Corner from the Mokutai Reckoners
